text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The summer days
flash by like shooting stars.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Regarding how Cesario, with her lofty perspective,
can attain the "radiance" needed as a guide
and the "desperate resolve" that inspires admiration.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I spent my days carrying an assignment with no clear answer.
Then, one night.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Ah, there you are, Cesario!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Cesario went on a night run
together with Rhein Kraft.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Well then, I'm off.
I'll contact you immediately if any problems arise.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Along the nighttime beach where waves ebb and flow, two figures dashed off.
Their slender backs vanished into the dusk in the blink of an eye—

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Haah, haah, haah, haah...!
Heheh♪

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: (...What's gotten into her? Craft seems to be in an exceptionally good mood...)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: All right... Let's go, Cesario!

text_block_list.name: Cesario & Craft
text_block_list.text:
Yaaaaah!
Haaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Phew... We've come quite far, haven't we?
Let's turn back right after a short rest.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, sorry about that.
I was having so much fun that I ran too far.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Craft... You sure seem to be in high spirits.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, that's right. I've just been so excited
ever since around last summer!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"Because after the Oka Sho ended,
I thought I'd never get to run with
Cesario again!"

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha!
Jeez, you're always exaggerating, Craft.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Sure, a lot has happened, but the possibility
of running the same race from the Senior Class onward
has always been there, hasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Hey, that's true, but—why is that!
I just had this feeling... It's weird of me, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"Still, that's why, you know?
I'm just so happy to be able to run this much now~."

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
I'm even more, way more thrilled than when we were fighting over the Triple Tiara—
I just want to race Cesario as much as possible!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: So, you know—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—And Rhein Kraft looked up at the sky.
Stars twinkled brightly in her eyes.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
I'm not going to run
in the Sprinters Stakes anymore.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: And that's why she's entering the Queen Elizabeth II Cup.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
2,200 meters—it might be a bit long for me, sure.
But... none of that matters. I just want to race that badly.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"The next race will be a battle against me,
Cesario."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —And with that, Rhein Kraft took the bewildered Cesario's hand.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
...Cesario, who grew
even stronger upon entering the Senior Year.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
If I could race the current you,
and if I could win against you—

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"I just know that I can become
a light that shines brighter than anyone else."

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
A light connecting all the way into the distant future.
Surpassing you, I will become that light.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: I will be the light...!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm sorry for being this kind of friend.
And for one more thing... I'm even more sorry."

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
I'm so glad you're here, Cesario.
I really, truly mean that right now.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The beach fell completely silent.
Only the sound of the waves echoed against the rocks—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Eventually... Cesario mutters softly.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: ...Kraft.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
To me... my own wish to pass the baton
is a mere triviality.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: What matters more is that the great river woven by Umamusume across generations becomes even vaster and grander—

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: "As someone weaving that legacy, I want to be its cornerstone." That's what I've always believed.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
However—yet right now,
why is that?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
A feeling that "it has to be me" has taken root,
and it won't go away...!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: You are—

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Talking about our dreams again and again,

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: It was precisely because it was you, who had walked beside me all along—!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Even if my body rots away,
yielding is the one thing I could never stomach...!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: My heart is... burning, burning with excitement...!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"I accept your challenge at the Queen Elizabeth II Cup!
I will not let you win, under any circumstances!"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: ...Ngh, yeah!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A fierce wish that flared up for a fleeting moment on a summer night.
That fire burned through even Cesario's reason—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Brought forth a new destiny.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Trainer...!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: "Finally, I finally understand—the resolve behind that 'radiance' that day...!"

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: The hearts of Messiah-san and Heart-san, who wished and fought with the resolve to burn out!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Therefore, please allow me to entrust my dream to you!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"The Queen Elizabeth II Cup...
In order to beat Line Craft...!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As Cesario spoke, her eyes—
shone with the brilliant sparkle of stars.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Even if it means staking everything I have,
I will defeat Rhein Kraft!
